phase3.gigsHelp.en: Short local jobs. Check parole conditions with your officer. Phone numbers are never shown.
phase3.gigsHelp.draft: Hojiiwwan naannoo gabaabaa qaban, haala yeroo murtaaʼeef kenname qoratanii hojjetaa keessanitti himaa. Lakkoofsi bilbilaa hin mulʼatu.

phase3.housingHelp.en: Savings goals plus a housing-readiness plan. Groundwork does not provide housing and does not partner with providers. For local help, call 211.
phase3.housingHelp.draft: Galmawwan qusannaa dabalatee karoora qophii mana jireenyaa. Groundwork mana jireenyaa hin kennu akkasumas dhiyeessitoota waliin hin hojjetu. Gargaarsa naannoo argachuuf 211 bilbila.

phase3.paidNote.en: Paid plan. No price has been set yet.
phase3.paidNote.draft: Qophiin kaffaltii qabu, gatiin isaa garuu hin murtoofne.

reentry.crisisStep.en: Save these numbers now. You can also tap Need help now at the top of any screen.
reentry.crisisStep.draft: Lakkoofsa kana amma fayyaduu dandeessa. Tajaajilli si barbaachisa jedhus taphachuu dandeessa.

reentry.steps.step14.en: Put every court date and check-in on a calendar
reentry.steps.step14.draft: Guyyaa mana murtiitti dhihaataniifi galgala itti galmaaʼan hunda sagantaa irratti galmeessi

reentry.steps.step17.en: Check your fines, fees and restitution
reentry.steps.step17.draft: Adabbii adabbii, kaffaltii fi kaffaltii kaffaltii kee sakatta'i

reentry.steps.step19.en: Enroll in Medicaid, and SNAP if you need it
reentry.steps.step19.draft: Gargaarsa fayyaatiif galmaaʼi, akkasumas yoo si barbaachise SNAP

reentry.steps.step7.en: Find a safe place to stay (call 211 or local housing resources)
reentry.steps.step7.draft: Bakka tasgabbaa'aa ta'e barbaadi (waamicha 211 ykn meeshaalee mana jireenyaa naannichaa)

reentry.steps.step8.en: Find food for this week (call 211 or a local food pantry)
reentry.steps.step8.draft: Nyaata torban kanaaf ta'u barbaadi (waamicha 211 ykn mana nyaataa naannichaa)

safety.relapseDraft.en: Draft — for review. Calm first steps for the first 24 hours after a slip will appear here once reviewed. You are not alone.
safety.relapseDraft.draft: Xiyyeeffannoon kan kennamuufii qabu, yeroo jalqabaatiif sa'aatii 24f tasgabbaa'aa ta'uu qaba.

safety.vaultHelp.en: Your documents are encrypted. Paid plan feature; no price has been set yet.
safety.vaultHelp.draft: Barreeffamoonni kee iccitii qabu. Qophiin kaffaltii qabu; gatiin hin murteeffamne.

support.resourcesNote.en: Legal aid, treatment and transit. This directory does not cover food or housing.
support.resourcesNote.draft: Gargaarsi seeraa, yaalii fayyaa fi geejjiba; galmeen kun nyaata ykn mana jireenyaa hin ilaalu.

wellbeing.roughHelp.en: You are not alone. The crisis button above is always here — call or text 988, or 911 in an emergency.
wellbeing.roughHelp.draft: Isin kophaa keessan miti. Tooftaan rakkoon itti uumame yeroo hunda asitti argama  —  yeroo hatattamaa bilbila ykn ergaa gabaabaa 988 yookiin 911.

work.paroleNote.en: Check your parole or probation conditions with your officer before applying.
work.paroleNote.draft: Tarkaanfii fudhachuukee dura waa'ee haala eeyyama ykn eeyyama kee hojjetaa kee wajjin mari'adhu.
